learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use mathematics, science and engineering knowledge in analysis and design of industrial wastewater treatment processes.
Developing professional ethics and responsibility awareness in terms of environmental protection.

syllabus_topics: Introduction; General Concepts, Sources and Characteristics of Industrial Wastes, Wastewater Treatment Processes
Preliminary and Primary Treatment; Balancing, Neutralization
Preliminary and Primary Treatment, Sedimentation, Oil Separation, Flotation
Biological Wastewater Treatment Processes; Ventilation Pools, Activated Sludge Processes
Biological Wastewater Treatment Processes; Trickling Filters, Rotary Biological Filters
Biological Wastewater Treatment Processes; Anaerobic Processes
bibliography: Metcalf and Eddy, Inc. "Waste Water Engineering, Treatment, Disposal, and Reuse", 4. Basım, Mc Graw Hill Inc., 2003.
Eckenfelder, W.W.(Jr.), "Industrial Water Pollution Control", 3. Basım, Mc Graw Hill Inc., 2000.
